title: Islamiyat
subtitle: Islamic Studies · CSS 2026
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Review carefully.

questions.text: Who is the author of the book "The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam"?
questions.explanation: Allama Iqbal's lectures (1930).

questions.text: According to the MUFASSIRIN, what is meant by "في سبيل الله" in the heads of Zakat?
questions.explanation: Most mufassirin interpret it as Jihad / those striving in Allah's cause.

questions.text: During the Hudaybiyyah diplomacy, under whose protection did Hazrat Usman Ghani (RA) enter Makkah?
questions.explanation: Protection was given by Aban bin Saeed bin al-Aas — closest option is C.

questions.text: Who is the author of the book on Seerah titled "Khutbat-e-Madras"?
questions.explanation: Syed Sulaiman Nadvi's Madras lectures (1925).

questions.text: According to Holy Quran, in which matter are men and women equal?
questions.explanation: Al-Ahzab 33:35 / Aal-Imran 3:195 — equal reward.

questions.text: According to which Surah, the killing of one human being is equal to the killing of all mankind?
questions.explanation: Al-Ma'idah 5:32.

questions.text: Who is the author of "The Clash of Civilizations"?
questions.explanation: Samuel P. Huntington (1996).

questions.text: Which Islamic organization was established in the year 1969?
questions.explanation: OIC was founded in Rabat, September 1969.

questions.text: In which school of thought is the principle of 'ISTEHSAN' most extensively applied?
questions.explanation: Istihsan is most associated with the Hanafi school (not listed).

questions.text: Which status of the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) has been most prominently highlighted in the Holy Qur'an and Sunnah?
questions.explanation: 'I have been sent as a teacher' (Ibn Majah); Al-Jumu'ah 62:2.

questions.text: Polygamy is allowed for a man under which condition?
questions.explanation: An-Nisa 4:3 — only if one can do justice.

questions.text: In the final major address to the Ummah, what type of equality did the Prophet (ﷺ) emphasize?
questions.explanation: Khutbat-ul-Wida: no Arab is superior to a non-Arab.

questions.text: Which act of worship highlights the universality of Islam?
questions.explanation: Hajj gathers Muslims of all races and nations.

questions.text: According to Almighty Allah, what is the basis of being most honored?
questions.explanation: Al-Hujurat 49:13.

questions.text: The verse (إني جاعل في الأرض خليفة) states:
questions.explanation: Khilafah (vicegerency) = trust and responsibility.

questions.text: Which is considered the first battle led by the Prophet (ﷺ) in Islamic history?
questions.explanation: Ghazwa Abwa (Waddan), 2 AH, was the first expedition he led personally.

questions.text: What was the greatest obstacle in the enforcement of law which the Prophet (ﷺ) removed through his practical Sunnah?
questions.explanation: Makhzumi woman case: 'even if Fatima stole…'.

questions.text: When one person provides capital and the other provides labor and both share profit and loss, what is it called?
questions.explanation: Mudarabah: rabb-ul-maal + mudarib.

questions.text: What was the common central point of the message of all the Prophets?
questions.explanation: Tawheed — An-Nahl 16:36.

questions.text: How many basic conditions are required for a Hadith to be regarded as authentic?
questions.explanation: Continuous chain, 'adl narrators, dabt, no shudhudh, no 'illah.
